TITLE: Bookmarks
EMPTY: No bookmarks. Use the plus button to add one, or import a list from Manage.
LABEL: Label
DEFAULTS_UNAVAILABLE: The default bookmarks file could not be loaded or is invalid.
IMPORT_SHAPE: Paste a JSON array of bookmarks, like one downloaded with Export, or drop or upload a JSON file to replace the text.
IMPORT_CHOOSE: How should the {count} bookmarks be imported?
MERGE_INFO: Keeps your {current} current bookmarks and adds {added} new ones. Exact duplicates (same label, link and subsection) are skipped.
REPLACE_INFO: Removes your {current} current bookmarks and replaces them with these {count}. This cannot be undone.
INVALID: Use a non-empty label and an http:// or https:// URL.
INVALID_IMPORT: Invalid file. Expected an array of browser bookmarks with labels and HTTP(S) targets, optional subgroups, and no embed or shell options.
STORAGE_ERROR: Browser storage is unavailable. Changes last only until you reload; export to keep a copy.
DROP_TO_ADD: Drop a link to add a bookmark
HELP_DROP: Drag a link from the address bar or another page onto this window to add it as a bookmark.
HELP_KEYBOARD: Use the Up and Down arrow keys to move through the bookmark list, from the search field into the rows and back. This works in every view.
HELP_EDIT: In the rows view, open a row's ⋯ menu to edit or delete that bookmark, and use the plus button (top right on phones) or Add bookmark on Manage to add one. Clicking a row opens its link.
HELP_NAVIGATION: Use the sidebar to switch between Bookmarks, Manage and Settings. On narrow screens, open it with the menu button.
HELP_FAVORITES: In Bookmarks, star a link to pin it to a Favorites group at the top. Favorites are kept separately from the bookmark list.
HELP_STORAGE: Everything is stored in this browser only. There is no sync between devices or sites, and clearing browser data removes it. Export to keep a copy.
HELP_IMPORT: Export, Import and Clear all bookmarks are on Manage. Import accepts pasted JSON or a JSON file exported here, and Set to default JSON fills it with the default links. Merge skips exact duplicates; Replace swaps the whole list.
